subject: increase size of text in headers

messages.author: 91cb0e6e64fe2a61
messages.subject: increase size of text in headers
parts:
I have a plot made in ggplot 2, kind of like the one seen in the example: http://docs.ggplot2.org/0.9.3.1/facet_wrap.html

I am trying to make the headers ('sim', 'real') larger.. On my plot, they are tiny. I cannot seems to accomplish this, though I'm sure it is super easy! Can anybody show me how to do this?

The code I'm using right now is this:


p1 <- ggplot(subset(trim.df,variable == 'sim'),
            aes(x = PHRED, y = value, fill = PHRED)) + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(50000,56000), oob = rescale_none) +
            facet_wrap(~variable) +
            geom_bar() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c('raw','1','5','10','20')) +
            ylab("Number of Errors") +
            xlab("") +
            theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=15), legend.position = "none", axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(1.5)),  axis.title.x = element_text(size = rel(1.5)))

p2 <- ggplot(subset(trim.df,variable == 'real'),
            aes(x = PHRED, y = value, fill = PHRED)) + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(11000,15000), oob = rescale_none) +
            facet_wrap(~variable) +
            geom_bar() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c('raw','1','5','10','20')) +
            ylab("Number of Errors") +
            xlab("Phred Trimming Level") +
            theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=15), legend.position = "none", axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(1.5)),  axis.title.x = element_text(size = rel(1.5)))
grid.arrange(p1,p2)

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: increase size of text in headers
parts:
add 

strip.text.x=element_text(size=12)

(replace 12 with desired size) to your theme() call.

Best,
Ista
